title: antirrhinum majus var. intermedium
intro: Antirrhinum majus var. intermedium, commonly known as the Intermediate Snapdragon or Half-hardy Perennial Snapdragon, is a plant species within the Antirrhinum genus. This flowering plant is known for its trumpet-shaped flowers and is often used in gardens and landscapes for its vibrant colors and ability to attract pollinators. The plant has been reported to have several health benefits, including antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and soothing skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Antirrhinum majus var. intermedium include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
